name: Dagna Anvilheart

textures.Normal: linear, tangent +Y, flat normal surface; geometric bevels

equipment: weighted within the skeletal mesh; socket bones also available

source_brief.silhouette: A broad low center of gravity, square apron panels and a single large two-handed hammer held across the body. One uncovered upper sleeve breaks the armored outline without exposing a vulnerable-looking costume.
source_brief.face: Deep brown skin, bright gray eyes and black hair in a thick high braid coiled at the back. A stern resting expression softens during the victory pose.
source_brief.costume: Red workshop coat beneath segmented shoulder armor, a short split leather apron and heavy wrapped boots. Metal is limited to the shoulders, wrists and tool head.
source_brief.palette: Brick red #A64E45; soot #4A4343; honey leather #A67E4B; steel #AAB2B7.
source_brief.equipment: A blocky fantasy forge hammer with a large beveled face and short decorative rune strip. The tool reads from shape rather than detailed mechanical parts.
source_brief.signature: Wide hammer bar, red split coat and squared apron silhouette.
source_brief.materials: Coarse leather, wool, lightly worn iron and painted wood. Use broad edge accents to suggest craft rather than gritty damage.
source_brief.back: A simple crossed harness stabilizes the hammer rest pose; the braid coil stays above the shoulder blades and outside the swing path.
source_brief.animation: Idle holds the hammer diagonally with settled elbows. Walk uses strong grounded steps. Basics use a short overhead arc. The active pivots through one wide sweep, then returns to the same tile.
source_brief.vfx: A low pale-gold sweep arc traces only the adjacent-cell ring; no knockback or extra stun.
source_brief.audio: A broad whoosh and compact stone-on-metal fantasy impact, limited to one main active sound even with several victims.
source_brief.risk: The sweep must not imply a larger hit radius than the data. Avoid excessive root rotation that changes gameplay facing or shifts the feet.

exported_coordinate_units: centimeters: temporary geometry, rest translation and animation location values multiplied by100; authoring source remains meters
